title: Building the compute infrastructure for the Intelligence Age
summary: OpenAI scales Stargate to build the compute infrastructure powering AGI, adding new data center capacity to meet growing AI demand.
body: OpenAI scales Stargate to build the compute infrastructure powering AGI, adding new data center capacity to meet growing AI demand.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布扩展Stargate算力基础设施项目，旨在通过增加数据中心容量来满足AGI研发对算力的巨大需求。此举反映了头部模型厂商在算力竞赛中的战略重心，即通过大规模基础设施建设保障模型训练与推理的持续扩展。

aiReview.reasonZh: 涉及大模型算力基础设施的战略布局，对行业资源分配具有宏观影响。
